name: every_starter
caption:
IF OUR STARTING FIVE WERE POKÉMON 🎮🏀

🧠 PG Immanuel Quickley = Alakazam: the Pokédex says its IQ is 5,000. Ours just goes by IQ. 5.6 assists a night
🐢 SG Ja'Kobe Walter = Wartortle: say it fast. 2.3 threes and 11.1 points a night
🐂 SF RJ Barrett = Tauros: once it starts running, it won't stop. 21.3 a night
🧬 PF Scottie Barnes = Mew: learns every move, does it all. 23.5 a night
😴 C Jakob Poeltl = Snorlax: blocks the road, nobody gets past. 61.7% from the field

Who would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If our starting five were Pokemon, who'd be who?
Point guard. Immanuel Quickley is Alakazam.
The Pokedex says its I Q is five thousand. Ours just goes by I Q.
beats.dlg: ITS IQ IS 5,000.|OURS GOES BY IQ.

beats.vo: Five point six assists a night.
Shooting guard. Jah-Kobe Walter is War-tortle.
Two point three made threes and eleven point one points a night.
Small forward. RJ Barrett is Tauros.
Once it starts running, it won't stop until it hits something. That's RJ going downhill.
beats.dlg: ONCE IT STARTS RUNNING,|IT WON'T STOP.

beats.vo: Power forward. Scottie Barnes is Mew.
Mew can learn every move in the game. Scottie does it all.
beats.dlg: MEW CAN LEARN EVERY MOVE.|SCOTTIE DOES IT ALL.

beats.vo: Our franchise. Twenty-three point five a night.
In the games, Snorlax blocks the road. Nobody gets past.
beats.dlg: SNORLAX BLOCKS THE ROAD.|NOBODY GETS PAST.

beats.vo: Sixty-one point seven percent from the field.
That's a party we're taking into any gym.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'RE TAKING|INTO ANY GYM.
